{{Quote|You have no business with us, outsider.|Lika Fimente, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GtM" />}}
'''Lika Fimente''' was a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The other tasks will help us, but return of our people is paramount. Could you please inspect the smuggler base and look for our den mates?|Lika Fimente, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GtM" />}}
Lika Fimente was a Selonian who belonged to the [[Neetha Den]]. The den inhabited a [[Neetha Den's cave|cave]] near the city of Nashal, on the planet Talus of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG:GtM" />
[[File:Smuggler_Base.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Smuggler Base]].]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], several Selonians of the den were captured by the [[Talusian Smugglers]] and kept as hostages in order to force the rest of the den into mining for them.<ref name="SWG:TtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Travel to Talus|Talus}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] was aware of the situation but was unable to intervene in Selonians matters. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] thus recruited an independent spacer in order to help the Seloninans without involving the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:TtT" /> The spacer met [[Kiki Dorente]], advisor to the [[Kiisa Kimotte|den mother]], and the Seloninans accepted the assistance.<ref name="SWG:TtK">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Talk to Kiki" on Talus</ref> After the spacer performed a reconnaissance of the [[Smuggler Base]] where the den mates where supposedly held, the Selonians developed a strategy against the smugglers. Kiki Dorente sent back the spacer to the smuggler base in order to gather information about the destination of the cargo shuttles leaving the base.<ref name="SWG:FaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Finding a Weakness" on Talus</ref> [[Tika Sileste]] requested the spacer to eliminate the smuggler guards and destroy the droids in the base.<ref name="SWG:EaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Exploiting a Weakness" on Talus</ref> [[Ravi Thienta]] asked the spacer to recover stolen Selonian's supplies and destroy the smugglers weapons cache.<ref name="SWG:UYT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Under Your Thumb|Talus}}</ref> Furthermore, Lika Fimente tasked the spacer to find the captive Selonians in the base.<ref name="SWG:GtM" /> Although the spacer achieved most of the objectives, the assault was only a partial success. The spacer defeated most of the smugglers, including their leader,<ref name="SWG:EaW" /> and crippled their ability to exploit the Selonians.<ref name="SWG:UYT" /> However, the spacer discovered that the captive Selonians had already been shipped to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. As the situation with the smugglers was solved, the spacer eventually returned to the Selonian cave and was rewarded by Lika Fimente.<ref name="SWG:GtM" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LikaFimente.jpg|200px|thumb|Randomly generated depiction of Lika Fimente]]
[[File:TemplateSelonianScout.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Lika Fimente]]
Lika Fimente appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GtM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lika Fimente was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
